text: Some U.S. states have held a presidential election entirely by mail.
seenIn: a cable segment calling mail voting “untested”

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: Pew Research Center, American Trends Panel Wave 57
room.questionWording: As far as you know, have any U.S. states ever conducted voting in a presidential election entirely by mail?
room.note: 41% not sure and 1% no answer, shown together as unsure.

truthSource.label: NCSL: States With All-Mail Elections
truthSource.oneLine: Oregon has held all-mail elections since 2000, Washington since 2012 and Colorado since 2014, presidential elections included.

lesson.tip: Calling something new and untested makes it sound risky. A quick history check (when did this start, where?) often shows decades of track record.
